settings.workspaceDescription: Manage your workspace name, logo, and general settings.

account.title: Account
account.signOutDescription: Sign out of your account on this device.
account.manageProfileDescription: Change your profile picture, email, full name, and username.
account.appearanceDescription: Choose how Feediyo looks to you.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.detailsPlaceholder: What happened? What did you expect?
feedback.noMatchFilter: No feedback matches the current filters.

widget.embedDescription: Add a floating feedback button to any website with a single snippet.
widget.enableDescription: When disabled, the iframe returns 404 and the button won't appear.
widget.embedSnippetDescription: Paste both tags before {{tag}} on every page where you want the widget.
widget.identifyTitle: Optional — Link feedback to your users
widget.identifyDescription: The widget works without this. Add it later to see who submitted what.
widget.notConfiguredDescription: Set up the embed widget to collect feedback directly inside your app.
widget.dangerDescription: Regenerating the token will break any existing embed snippets immediately. You'll need to re-deploy the new snippet to all your sites.

share.title: Collect Feedback
share.subtitle: Get {{name}} in front of your users.
share.boardLiveDescription: Share it with your users, drop it in your docs, or link it from your website.
share.facebookDescription: Post to a page or group.
share.emailSignatureDescription: Add this to your sign-off. Every email you send becomes an invite.
share.addToApp: Add to your app or website
share.addToAppDescription: Drop these links into your help menu, footer, or docs. Set once, collect forever.
share.messagesDescription: Pick a channel, copy the message, paste it. Each one is written for {{name}}.
share.slackDescription: Drop this in a team or community channel.
share.emailDescription: Send this to customers you want to hear from.
share.communityDescription: For forums, groups, or anywhere your users gather.
share.supportDescription: Paste this into a ticket reply or canned response.
share.customerEmailDescription: Send this to your user list to kick things off.
share.developerDescription: Forward this to whoever handles your codebase.
